messages:
Priya: small but visible issue: code fence in the SDK snippet on /docs/sdk/python has been rendering as inline because of a trailing TAB char in the markdown.
Tom: oh that explains the failed snippet tests. which file?
Priya: `docs/sdk/python/quickstart.md` line ~42. the snippet that starts with ```python had a tab on the fence line.
Adele: nasty. I can patch it but we should add a lint rule to catch non-printable whitespace on code-fence lines.
Tom: added `mdast` based plugin to detect tab characters on fence lines. opened PR.
docs-bot: PR 613 created: docslint/code-fence-whitespace. CI pending.
Priya: also noticed the snippet example uses `redwood.Client()` but in the Python SDK it's now `redwood.InferenceClient()` - docs mismatch.
Adele: update the snippet while you're there. include a short migration note.
Tom: updated snippet and added a test that asserts fence not collapsed and sample passes.
docs-bot: lint and snippet tests passed. PR merged.
